description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] DESTRUCTIVE: permanently deletes an ad campaign in flayr and on its ad network. Cannot be undone; to stop spending but keep the campaign use ads_campaign_pause. A running campaign, or one that spent today, is refused unless `stopFirst: true`, which pauses it first. The answer reports whether it is gone in flayr (`flayr`) and on the network (`network`). Pass an `idempotencyKey` so a retry never deletes twice. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

idempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key never runs the delete twice. Also accepted as the Idempotency-Key header or in the body.

stopFirst.description: Pause a running campaign first, then delete it.

name: ads_delete_campaign
title: Delete an ad campaign
